[center][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffffff]Run all the way to Robin’s shop and she’s not there? Your duo suspiciously linger near your stash?[/color][/font][/size][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffffff][size=3]Any machine at home finish? Any tapper in the forest to collect? Is the community garden 9999 steps away ready?[/size][/color][/font][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffffff][size=4]Keep an eye on everything with a fully functional CCTV camera system.[/size][/color][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod adds a fully functional [b]Live Camera [/b]app into Smartphone, allowing you to see what's happening everywhere.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]CCTV Dashboard:[/b] A multi-cam grid to monitor your machines, tappers, and shady friends all at once.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Live View Mode:[/b] Click any feed to return to the game with a live picture-in-picture stream while you keep farming.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][center]
[img width=625]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50250/50250-1786344643-669480957.gif[/img][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]How thing works:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]To set up camera, simply open the app and click Add Camera. A camera will be set up at your current position.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]A list of camera allowing you to see every place at one. View refresh when enter the app/change the page.[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Click on a camera will return you to the game with the live-stream view, allowing you to see it live while still play the game.[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]You can move the camera, change the zoom, turn on flashlight and capture the view with the cam-control menu.[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]Should compat with every mods/maps/npcs...[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]On older device, you can reduce the refresh rate for better performance.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left]
